description: Get DeFi balances (Liquidity Pools, Yield Farming, Lending, etc.) for a single address, or a list of addresses.

_signals.x_guidance: All paid endpoints are at POST /x402/{tool}. Send a JSON body with the required fields for the tool. Payment is required via x402 (X-Payment header, Base USDC) or MPP (Authorization: Payment header, Tempo). Available tools: token-price, search, nft-token-metadata, nft-collection-metadata, portfolio-totals, token-balances, defi-balances, nft-balances, historical-token-price, transaction-details, transaction-history, token-holders, token-ranking, nft-ranking, account-identity, general-swap-feed, token-activity-feed.
